label: STOPP E2
title: Dabigatran with low kidney function
statement: Direct thrombin inhibitors (e.g., dabigatran) if eGFR < 30 ml/min/1.73m² (risk of bleeding)

source.document: O'Mahony D, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632, Appendix 1 (corrected supplementary file; NHS Somerset copy used for text, sentence-identical to the earlier parse)
source.citation: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y
source.credit: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y

plain_summary: Dabigatran is cleared mainly by the kidneys, so it builds up and raises the risk of bleeding when kidney function is low (eGFR below 30). Australian guidance differs: dabigatran is contraindicated when Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance is below 30 mL/min (TGA, 2013).

medicine_groups.name: Direct thrombin inhibitors (dabigatran)
medicine_groups.note: Dabigatran capsules contain dabigatran etexilate. Both ingredient names identify the same supply. Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too.

needs_facts.meets: Enter the eGFR in mL/min/1.73 m² and its test date if known. The latest result that applies to the dabigatran course meets this criterion if it is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m².

rule_for_models: Apply this criterion only if the patient is aged 65 years or older. If age is unknown, ask for age confirmation before assessing the supply. For dabigatran (Group A), use the latest eGFR that applied during the course, including a result before supply if it still applies. A result measured after the course ended cannot establish a finding for that course. Below 30 mL/min/1.73 m², report a finding and cite the supply and result. At 30 or above, there is no finding for that course. If the value is unknown or its timing is unclear, report only a possible finding and ask for the eGFR that applied during treatment. Use the test date or a confirmed link to treatment, never the date the pharmacist entered the answer.
cannot_be_seen: The latest kidney test if none is on the record, whether the dose was reduced after the test, and the reason for the anticoagulant.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm the current Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance and review whether dabigatran is suitable given the bleeding risk?
